metadata.case_name: LAM NGAI CHUNG v. CHEUNG WAN CHUEN

injuries.description: an 8 cm laceration over his right forearm with a torn brachioradialis muscle
source: an 8 cm laceration over his right forearm with a torn brachioradialis muscle.
injuries.icd_description: Laceration of other flexor muscle, fascia or tendon at forearm level

injuries.description: injury to the Branchial Plexus, the intersection of nerves in the neck and shoulder
source: Dr Wedderburn concludes that there can be no doubt that the plaintiff injured the Branchial Plexus, the intersection of nerves in the neck and shoulder.
injuries.icd_description: Injury of multiple nerves at shoulder or upper arm level

injuries.description: redness over his chest wall, abrasions over his right shoulder, right arm, right knee and face; graft scar on right forearm and a 4" x 4" scar on the right thigh (donor area for the skin graft)
injuries.body_part: chest wall; right shoulder; right arm; right knee; face; right thigh (donor area)
source: redness over his chest wall, abrasions over his right shoulder, right arm, right knee and face
a graft scar 3" x 1 1/8 " across the front of the right forearm and a 4" x 4" scar on the right thigh, the donor area for the skin graft.

manifestations.description: scattered areas of numbness on the right arm
wasting of the deltoid muscle at the shoulder
right hand grip reduced to 50 lb compared with 80 lb in left hand
difficulty in moving his arm away from the body against pressure of the examiner's hand
no loss of co-ordination except in the limited movements using thumb and forefinger

superficial abrasion scar on the outside of his right knee, a small faint flat scar on his upper right chest, a 'T' shaped abrasion scar on the front of the upper arm and a graft scar on the right forearm

still feels numbness and has restricted movement of his arm; his hand is not as good as before the accident; his hand quivers when he uses needles; using scissors is more difficult and his hand and arm get tired more quickly
no longer wore 'T' shirts because of embarrassment over the scars on his arm

treatments_received: repair of the torn brachioradialis muscle

losses.description: Reduced dexterity, strength and co-ordination in the right hand and arm affecting ability to perform tailoring work (hand quivers with needles, difficulty with scissors, hand and arm tire more quickly; now takes 13-15 hours to complete work that took 10 hours)
Embarrassment over scars on his arm resulting in him no longer wearing T-shirts
